01 / THE PERSON BEHIND THE PROJECTS

Curious by nature.
Hands-on by choice.

Hi! I'm Phoebien, a BS Computer Applications student majoring in Embedded Systems at MSU-IIT.

My projects take me from microcontrollers and real-time firmware to computer vision and desktop applications. I work with sensors, write code, and build interfaces that make the information useful.

I'm part of an ongoing university-funded research project exploring edge-based aphid damage detection in bell peppers, and a co-author of a peer-reviewed EUSPN 2026 conference paper. Beyond technical work, I teach English online and contribute to student leadership and technology events.
